newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan cabinet ministers held Nomura VIP accounts.
newsitem.headline: Japan cabinet ministers held Nomura VIP accounts.

text.p: Three ministers in Japan's cabinet held so-called VIP accounts at Japan's largest brokerage, Nomura Securities Co Ltd, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Tuesday.

In an announcement that could have repercussions for Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's government, Mitsuzuka said an investigation had been carried out by Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama, and details of the investigation would be revealed later on Tuesday.
Asked whether he himself or his family members had conducted any transactions with Nomura, Mitsuzuka said: "No, there are none."
Nomura is currently under investigation for suspected illegal deals linked to a "sokaiya" racketeer. Two former Nomura executives and a third senior Nomura official have been arrested in the case.
